verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted document-processing API, so the axis applies. The pack documents no opt-out control for telemetry or usage tracking. On-prem and single-container deployment that keeps document data in your environment is a different control (data residency), not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
